typical_occasions: state dinners, some galas and balls
means: the most formal code: floor-length gowns; tailcoat for men
reach_for: floor-length gown, long gloves optional, tailcoat with white bow tie

typical_occasions: evening weddings, galas, formal award events
means: formal evening wear: long gown or very dressy cocktail dress; tuxedo for men
reach_for: floor-length or elegant midi dress, dressy separates in silk or satin, tuxedo
avoid: casual fabrics like denim or jersey, sneakers

means: black tie welcome but not required: a dark suit or a cocktail-to-long dress is fine
reach_for: long dress or dressy cocktail dress, dark suit with tie

means: one step below black tie: knee-to-midi dress or dressy separates; suit and tie
reach_for: cocktail or midi dress, sharp jumpsuit, suit and tie, heels or dressy flats

typical_occasions: daytime weddings, dinners out, work events in the evening
means: between cocktail and smart casual: polished dress or separates; suit, tie optional
reach_for: midi dress, skirt with a nice top, tailored trousers, blazer

typical_occasions: interviews, board meetings, formal work events
means: conservative tailoring in dark or neutral colours
reach_for: suit or pantsuit, sheath dress with blazer, closed-toe shoes

means: neat and professional without a full suit
reach_for: trousers or a knee-length skirt, button-up or knit top, blazer optional, loafers
avoid: t-shirts with logos, ripped jeans, flip-flops

means: casual pieces that look put together
reach_for: dark jeans or chinos, a nice top or shirt, clean sneakers or boots, light jacket
avoid: athletic wear, anything stained or worn out

typical_occasions: daytime hangouts, picnics, errands, casual parties
avoid: nothing in particular; dress for comfort and weather

means: cocktail-ish with permission to play: colour, velvet, sequins, metallics
reach_for: velvet or sequin dress, festive separates, a bold accessory
avoid: everyday office clothes with nothing special

means: dressy but built for heat, sand and wind
reach_for: light flowy midi or maxi dress, linen suit, flat sandals or wedges
avoid: stilettos (they sink), heavy fabrics, full tux

typical_occasions: raves, warehouse parties, clubs, EDM shows
means: dress to dance for hours: breathable, sweat-proof, shoes you can stand in; the theme or scene matters more than formality
reach_for: cropped or mesh top, tank, bike shorts or cargo pants, sneakers or comfy platforms, small crossbody bag
avoid: new or painful shoes, big bags, anything delicate or expensive
